name: stream-share-desktop
//productName: Read by Electron in dev so app.getName() matches the packaged build; electron-builder.yml sets it for the installer.

scripts.//build:native: Windows only. The target/dist-url pair is not optional: an addon built against Node's ABI loads in `node` and fails inside Electron, which is the only place it ever runs. Keep --target in step with the electron devDependency.
scripts.dist: pnpm build && pnpm build:native && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.release: pnpm build && pnpm build:native && electron-builder --publish always
scripts.//dist: build:native is not optional here: electron-builder copies native/build/Release/streamshare_capture.node as an extraResource, and a clean checkout has never built it. Without this the installer ships without HDR and says nothing.
